SwitchPreferenceCompat.app:title: Remember playback speed
SwitchPreferenceCompat.app:summary: Use the last speed you picked for the next videos

ListPreference.app:title: Skip interval
ListPreference.app:dialogTitle: Seconds skipped by the skip buttons and double-tap

SwitchPreferenceCompat.app:title: Remember playback position
SwitchPreferenceCompat.app:summary: Continue each video where you left off

SwitchPreferenceCompat.app:title: Remember last aspect ratio
SwitchPreferenceCompat.app:summary: Start with the mode you picked last time

SwitchPreferenceCompat.app:title: Volume boost (up to 200%)
SwitchPreferenceCompat.app:summary: Swipe or press volume up past 100% to amplify the player's sound. Never changes the system volume in the boost range. Very loud boost can distort on small speakers; needs device support

SwitchPreferenceCompat.app:title: Remember audio language
SwitchPreferenceCompat.app:summary: Pick the audio language you chose last time when a video has it

SwitchPreferenceCompat.app:title: Remember subtitle language
SwitchPreferenceCompat.app:summary: Prefer the subtitle language you chose last time

SwitchPreferenceCompat.app:title: Remember subtitle selection
SwitchPreferenceCompat.app:summary: Keep subtitles on or off like last time, and pick the same track when it's there

SwitchPreferenceCompat.app:title: Remember subtitle appearance
SwitchPreferenceCompat.app:summary: Keep size, color, background, position and delay changes made in the player

SwitchPreferenceCompat.app:title: Turn on subtitles automatically
SwitchPreferenceCompat.app:summary: Used when nothing is remembered yet: picks a track in your preferred language

EditTextPreference.app:title: Fallback subtitle language
EditTextPreference.app:dialogMessage: Language code, like en, hi or es. Used until you pick one in the player.

EditTextPreference.app:title: Fallback audio language
EditTextPreference.app:dialogMessage: Language code, like en, hi or ja. Used until you pick one in the player.

Preference.app:title: Forget remembered tracks
Preference.app:summary: Clears the remembered audio language, subtitle language and subtitle choice

SwitchPreferenceCompat.app:title: Enable picture-in-picture
SwitchPreferenceCompat.app:summary: Show the PiP button in the player (if your phone supports it)

ListPreference.app:title: PiP buttons
ListPreference.app:dialogTitle: Android shows about 3 buttons in the PiP window

SwitchPreferenceCompat.app:title: Auto-enter PiP when leaving
SwitchPreferenceCompat.app:summary: Shrink to a floating window if you go Home while a video plays

SwitchPreferenceCompat.app:title: Background audio
SwitchPreferenceCompat.app:summary: Keep audio playing when you leave the player (shows a media notification)
